name: The Cove
vibe: Upscale, adult-leaning wing. Built around 'luxury, sensuality, and white-glove Bahamian service.' Has its own pool and a private stretch of Cove Beach.
best_for: Couples, multigenerational families wanting a quieter, higher-end stay, or anyone who wants full resort access without the central bustle.
closest_to: KO SÀ WĂN by Ian Kittichai

name: The Royal
vibe: The iconic central tower — the silhouette in every Atlantis photograph. Most of the resort's signature amenities anchor here.
best_for: First-time visitors who want to be in the middle of everything. Families. Thrill-seekers — closest to Aquaventure's Mayan Temple entrance.

name: The Coral
vibe: Recently redesigned. Modern, fresh, lower-price entry point into the resort.
best_for: First-time families and value-conscious guests who still want full resort access.

name: The Reef
vibe: Residential-style luxury suites with kitchens — feels like a condo. Studios through specialty suites.
best_for: Longer stays. Multigenerational families needing space. Families who want to cook some meals.
